seams.title: Add prototype: cast a card with its alternative mana cost, colour, power and toughness
seams.clause: Prototype {2}{R} — 3/2 (You may cast this spell with different mana cost, color, and size. It keeps its abilities and types.)
seams.why: CR 702.160 / CR 718: a cast-time choice that gives the SPELL and the PERMANENT it becomes a second mana cost, power, toughness and (from the cost's coloured symbols) colour; the choice is part of the copiable values (CR 718.2a, 718.3c-d) and ends when the object leaves the stack or battlefield (CR 718.4). Nothing in the engine carries a second set of printed characteristics on one face. Expect: a prototype declaration on the Spec (cost, P/T) beside AlternativeCosts in effects/alternative_cost.go; a cast offer and CastProvenance flag in game (cast path, PaidCost); the layered view / copiable values in game reading the alternative mana cost, mana value, colour and base P/T while prototyped; the snapshot field (additive); protocol + client: the cast choice prompt and showing the prototyped cost and P/T on the stack item and the permanent (Scryfall layout 'prototype' is one face, the inset is only in oracle_text). Affinity/cost reducers, 'mana value' readers, colour readers and 'its power' readers must all see the prototyped values. The seam worker builds the eleven plain prototype cards; batch 21 holds the seven whose other text is rules-heavy.
seams.checked: grep -rni 'prototype' server/internal/cards server/internal/game docs/adding-cards.md client/src/lib -> only three unrelated card names. grep 'AltCostKey' effects/alternative_cost.go -> emerge, evoke etc., none changes P/T or colour. game/card.go:535 Layout is copied from Scryfall but nothing reads 'prototype'. Bestow (ADR 0141) changes types on the stack, not cost/P-T, so is a design reference only.

seams.title: Add offering: sacrifice a permanent as you cast, reduce by its mana cost, cast at instant speed
seams.clause: Artifact offering (You may cast this spell as though it had flash by sacrificing an artifact and paying the difference in mana costs between this and the sacrificed artifact. Mana cost includes color.)
seams.why: CR 702.48a-c: an OPTIONAL additional cost chosen at CR 601.2b that (a) reduces the total cost by the sacrificed permanent's MANA COST symbol by symbol (coloured reduces the same colour, excess reduces generic), and (b) grants instant timing only when it is paid. Emerge (effects/alternative_cost.go:515) is the nearest: it is an alternative cost, reduces generic by mana value, and has no timing leg. Expect an Offering(match) helper beside Emerge, a cost-reduction-by-mana-cost step in game's cast cost computation, and the legal-timing probe in server/internal/legal offering the flash cast only with a sacrifice chosen.
seams.checked: grep -rnE '702\.48|[Oo]ffering \(|(artifact|fox|rat|snake|goblin|moonfolk) offering|difference in mana costs' effects game -> no hit. grep 'offering' game/keywords.go -> one unrelated comment. No Patron of the Orochi/Kitsune/etc. in the catalog. The rest of the card ("Creatures attacking your opponents have double strike") is an ordinary static.
